name: Part-time online rater / evaluator (TELUS Digital AI Community)
organization: TELUS Digital AI Community (formerly TELUS International AI)
summary: TELUS Digital's AI Community hires people living in Canada as part-time freelancers to evaluate search, media and online-safety content from home.
whatYouDo: Depending on the posting (e.g. Internet Safety Evaluator, Online Data Analyst, Media Search Analyst), you review online content or search results against detailed guidelines and submit ratings. Work is part-time, remote and paid per completed task.
appeal: Several current-style postings are reserved for Canada residents, including French-language ones
Open-book qualification exam with study materials provided
Part-time and self-paced; some roles have no set hours
Run by the digital arm of a large Canadian company
watchOuts: Official estimate for Internet Safety Evaluator is about US$13.50/hr, paid per completed task
Must have lived in Canada 1–5 consecutive years depending on role
Blogs report no-task periods, sudden account 'under review' holds, and pay arriving weeks after the work month
Internet-safety work may involve viewing harmful content (not confirmed in posting snippets)
Freelance agreement: no guaranteed hours or benefits; TELUS told the Globe and Mail hours cannot be guaranteed

training.notes: Guidelines and learning materials before an open-book qualification exam; language test and ID verification also required.

compensation.notes: Internet Safety Evaluator – English (Canada) posting: estimated US$13.50/hr, paid per completed task, potentially more with productivity. Other Canada postings give no rate; one says pay depends on tasks completed and project availability.

reliability.notes: Globe and Mail (2023) quoted TELUS saying flexibility means hours cannot be guaranteed; 2026 blogs describe no-task periods. Anecdotal for recent years.

applicationSteps: Apply to a Canada posting on the TELUS Digital AI Community careers site
Study the guidelines and pass the open-book qualification exam within the set window
Complete ID verification and onboarding, then start tasks
fitsIf: You have lived in Canada for several years, follow detailed rules well, and want low-pressure part-time work from home.
notFitIf: You need more than about US$13–14/hr or guaranteed weekly hours.
